verdict.rationale: The docs show incident.io has a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, API key auth, and a reference site (docs-20, docs-34, docs-46, docs-86), but there is no mention anywhere of API versioning scheme or a documented deprecation policy for breaking changes. The probe even shows the openapi.json isn't reachable at standard paths, and no changelog entries discuss version deprecation.
